question: Should OpenClaw adopt SourceActor as a public channel/plugin SDK attribution contract with these field names, scalar mirrors, and role semantics?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the durable API shape affects plugin authors, prompt templates, Signal attribution semantics, and downstream memory work, so code review cannot choose the product contract on its own.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now; a maintainer can reopen or sponsor a narrowed SourceActor contract when the API direction is agreed.

options.title: Sponsor this API
options.body: Keep the PR open, land or rebase the Signal prerequisites first, and have an owner approve the SourceActor field names, role set, and compatibility plan.

options.title: Keep attribution plugin-local
options.body: Ask for a narrower Signal or integration-local attribution path that does not expose new public SDK/prompt fields yet.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now; a maintainer can reopen or sponsor a narrowed SourceActor contract when the API direction is agreed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the inbound context builder, plugin SDK seam refactors, and Signal event-handler surface involved in the decision.
